Brad's 4-leg HD order filled 9 cents under mid in one order: the first direct measure of what multi-leg execution is worth against legging.

Three earnings flies are open on a macro-veto day, all three before-the-open reporters, total max loss 911 of a 1,199 account: the result is the first evidence on the veto rule and on owner overrides (compare with the NVDA override of 2026-11-11).
